feature_contract.goal: Replay successful bounded partial D3D9 game backbuffer ColorFill in the active full-resolution native D3D11 menu/car/race Draw frame with D3D11.1 ClearView, preserving untouched pixels, native depth and game source ordinals with safe original D3D9/input fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: After real Draw/DrawIndexed, bounded ColorFill on same canonical backbuffer clears only requested D3D11.1 RTV rectangle and keeps other native game pixels.
Source frame Draw ordinals and previous full Clear/depth are preserved without changing original D3D9 Present, gamepad, FFB or SkyGlow.
Failed, foreign, pre-Draw, out-of-bounds or D3D11.0-only partial fills abort native batch and retain original game pixels and input.
Final validation-bearing SHA has unchanged required five GitHub Actions Gate success; Quest3/VDXR HMD evidence separate.
